title: Dynamic atom reloading for loss-tolerant surface-code memory
scope: Rotated surface-code memory at d=3,5; memory-X/Z; T=d,2d

method.name: Paired round-level circuit Monte Carlo with erasure-aware MWPM
method.settings: 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples; Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05; counter-addressed random streams
method.note: The simulator is deterministic for a frozen event stream, while finite-shot Monte Carlo estimates and the graph decoder remain statistical/baseline approximations.

figures.plots: FDR-qualified provisional classifications over the full public discovery grid

results.why: 502 of 1,960 comparisons favor active reload and none are classified harmful, but registered stopping remains incomplete.

figures.plots: Independent-seed paired precision and cell-level stopping

results.why: All 32 paired comparisons pass the pre-registered precision requirement.
Discovery and confirmation artifacts were atomically published and independently hash-verified.
